participation.context: Read the leaf and did not wipe it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You looked at the leaf before you went out. The words were the ones you wrote last night. You left them.

participation.context: Spoke low, at the fire, and did not write the line.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said who speaks first, and you corrected yourself. You named the ten pence and the cheese, and you left the sheets until you opened the cloth.

title: Said she speaks first, by the fire at Banbury

participation.context: Opened the cloth, looked, and closed it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You checked the paper and left it as it was. The shirt was wet. The sheets were not.
